description:
PhotoSweep is a focused storage cleaner for iPhone. It frees the space you actually control, your photo library, and gives honest, step-by-step guidance for everything iOS won't let an app touch.

WHAT IT DOES
• Storage dashboard: opens in about a second, even on a 100,000-photo library. Every number opens the list behind it, biggest first.
• Similar & duplicate photos: retakes, bursts and copies grouped on-device with Apple's Vision. Quick Clean keeps the best of each group. Start with the safest 20% (near-identical shots only), then 50% or all. Favorites are never suggested, and photos you choose to keep are remembered.
• iPhone or iCloud: see which originals sit on this iPhone and which live only in iCloud, so you know what deleting actually frees. Filter every list by it.
• Camera formats: spots what makes recent photos heavy (Live Photos, RAW, 48 MP) and shows where to change it in Settings.
• Large Videos: every video sorted by size, with thumbnails. Select and delete in bulk.
• Screenshots: grouped by month; clear a whole month in one tap.
• App Cleanup guide: deep links and simple steps to clear the cache of storage-heavy apps (Telegram, Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok, YouTube, and more).

HONEST BY DESIGN
iOS sandboxes every app, so no app can read or clear another app's cache or "System Data". Apps that claim to are only clearing their own. PhotoSweep doesn't pretend. It cleans your media and guides you for the rest.

SAFE
Deletions go to Recently Deleted. iOS shows its own confirmation and nothing is gone for 30 days. Your photos are analyzed on-device and never leave your phone. No account, no ads, no tracking; the app sends only anonymous usage counts, and you can switch them off.
promotionalText: Out of space? Find duplicates, huge videos and heavy RAW / Live Photos, and see what is on your iPhone versus iCloud. On-device, honest, no account.
